1.
This Public Interest Litigation has been preferred seeking the following relief:
"...to issue a writ of mandamus declaring the action of the official respondents in not prohibiting the manufacturing and sale of Gutka and Panmasala and also in not restraining the sale of Tobacco products nearby HCJ & DVSS, J Educational Institutions and to the persons below 18 years as illegal, arbitrary and contrary to the Provisions of 2.3.4 of the Food Safety and Standards Regulations 2011 and the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisements and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production,
Supply and Distribution) Act 2003 and consequently, direct the respondents to prohibit the Gutka and Panmasala and further direct the respondents to prohibit the sale of tobacco products in any Oruganti Naresh Kumar vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 3 November, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199058235/
1 form within 100 radius of Educational Institutions and their sale to the persons below 18 years and to pass such other or further orders as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the circumstances of the case."
2. It is a common ground that by issuing notification dated 06.12.2021, the State Government has imposed ban on sale of Gutka & Tobocco Products.
Even though the said notification is under challenge in separate writ proceedings pending before this Court, the fact remains that the State Government has exercised its power to impose ban on the sale of Gutka.
Therefore, this public interest litigation has been rendered infructuous.
